description: This file implements the Telemetry functionality for a WPEFramework plugin, including report uploading, privacy mode handling, and configuration management. It defines the TelemetryImplementation class with methods for registration, event dispatching, and external communication via RBus and RFC parameters.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including registration, event handling, configuration, and communication with external systems.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry plugin with the service, sets up power management, privacy mode, and report profiles.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile to STARTED or COMPLETE via RFC parameters.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value, sending it via telemetry.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers the upload of telemetry report via RBus.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing telemetry report upload via RBus.

methods.name: SetOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets the telemetry opt-out status by writing to a file.

methods.name: IsOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Reads the telemetry opt-out status from a file.
